source_evidence:
PLAY-REC-D277-278-HARROW-CARAVAN-DEPARTURE-001
Player exact directive at confirmed Day277~19:00 Copper Hearth after companions' individual city visits, V Keld/Harrow & Pike follow-up and reunion: "lets arrange to travel with the caravan, safety in numbers". This authorizes approach to known Harrow & Pike eastbound freight group and traveling in own four-horse coach alongside, with ordinary overnight rest and existing two-room lodging until planned morning Day278 departure; not spending for a paid escort or acquiring control over civilian freight. Cirren endorses extra road witnesses while stressing visibility and no guarantee. At about19:45 Day277 the still-active dispatch yard introduces independent adult caravan wagonmaster SELLA BRANT, matter-of-fact leader of three existing prepared-to-depart ordinary freight wagons (2 horses each), three drivers incl Sella (2014 Commoners AC10 HP4 each if needed) and TWO paid company guards (ordinary2014 Guard profile AC16 HP11 each). Caravan has private freight; cargo and draft animals remain its owners' and are not V's. Sella agrees to let V's capable four-horse enclosed coach join on mutual-deterrent terms WITHOUT fee or special fighting obligation; each party keeps own baggage/supplies, guards protect their own lives/cargo, coach remains its own unit and leader sets slower loaded-wagon pace. No mandatory guard duty or promised magic/protection/contract pay. Planned meet at dispatch yard and departure Day278 morning; no forced V speech, money, item or personal spell/feature expenditure for this agreement.
After evening meeting return to established secure Copper Hearth, same precisely TWO comfortable rooms shared by four without presuming which adult sleeps with whom; another ordinary one-night stay during Day277→278, charged same established line items once: 2x8sp rooms=1gp6sp, 4x5sp horse stable+coach=2gp, 6x5sp companion evening+breakfast meals=3gp, total6gp6sp. V personal purse975gp9sp6cp ->969gp3sp6cp; no extra stabling, deposits, tax, travel fee or caravan charge. V as Reborn does not eat; Mara/Cirren/Fenar each have two paid meals; horse feed provided in purchased stabling service so no separate debit to carried feed at dawn278. Quiet genuinely protected city overnight qualifies +2 weighted LongRest NEW cycle0/6→2/6 by Day278 dawn (NOT a complete fresh Long Rest), no random night occurrence in secure city, all HP/HD/feature/spells already full unchanged. Carried travel provisions remain21 ration-person-days and28 horse-feed animal-days, next ordinary consumption to assess upon actual Day279 morning.
At Day278 morning V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar leave Caer Veylan with Sella's three company wagons, behind/intermixed within sight at own coach speed, head east toward Eastwatch on well-maintained HEAVILY PATROLLED western Veyr inland road, ordinary professional freight pace. Day278 predeclared DAY encounter threshold01–07. Genuine executed Python secrets uniform d100 occurrence FACE4 => triggered ONE daytime event; independently executed second genuine Python secrets type d100 FACE87 => PEOPLE/TRADERS/PATROLS/SOCIAL result from official table category77–92, not a hostile encounter, NO severity roll or monster stat block. Around midday at public watering place convoy meets TWO independent westbound merchandise wagons whose adult older merchant EDRAN FENN exchanges road observations and greetings with Sella. He knows the eastbound road toward Eastwatch is open with regular patrols, trade manifests receiving more scrutiny at commercial controls; truthful public travel news, no special secret, detour, reward or forced V help. Sella trades practical westbound observations, neither convoy steals, fights, accompanies, hires V or forces a checkpoint encounter; both independently continue opposite ways. This social encounter consumes single Day278 travel random encounter; per travel rules no extra Day278 night encounter check if exposed camp, though actual night has NOT occurred. Before darkness Day278 late afternoon Sella independently selects a broad OPEN roadside dry clearing adequate for freight, parks 3 wagons in loose line with room for V coach, company hired guards set watch; Fenar voluntarily takes early watch because she enjoys it, no Rage/Shift/limited resource. V did not volunteer a watch shift or promise combat service. Party and four healthy V horses + intact coach all at camp with Sella's caravan. NO qualifying overnight yet, no Day279 food/feed debit or rest, no Day278 nighttime outcome. Time about17:30 Day278. V48/48 HP HD7/7 AC19 full MP7/7 Psi6/6 Sup4/4 ActionSurge/SecondWind, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 slots4/4,3/3,3/3 Channel2/2, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy, shared provisions21/28, V purse969gp3sp6cp, single unused sealed Pixie Dust still V-owned, sword/A-04/etc intact. No imposed escort fee, unplayed route mile count, later road hazard, additional business or quest accepted.
pending_action: Day278 ~5:30PM at an ordinary exposed inland roadside camp on the heavily patrolled Caer Veylan–Eastwatch trade road. V's four-horse coach is accompanying Sella Brant's three-wagon Harrow & Pike freight caravan at loaded-wagon pace by mutual no-fee arrangement; Sella/three drivers/two hired Guard-profile guards act independently, no hire/escort guarantee or V duties imposed. Midday Day278 random event genuine d1004 trigger, type87 social: independent westbound merchant Edran Fenn exchanged open-road/manifests information, then departed; no combat. Day278 night has NOT elapsed, but because daytime encounter occurred, no night random encounter per route cap. Sella's guards take ordinary watch and Fenar volunteers early watch; no rest completed at camp yet. Day277→278 second night at Copper Hearth two rooms/stables/meals cost6gp6sp, V purse969gp3sp6cp. LongRest new cycle2/6, V48/48 HD7/7 MP7/7 Psi6/6 Sup4/4 full, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 slots full, Mara healthy, all V horses and coach healthy; 21 rations-person-days/28 horse-feed animal-days still unconsumed after paid inn breakfast, one sealed Pixie Dust. Await V's camp conversation/next action or continuation of eastward caravan travel and actual Day278 night/Day279 dawn resources. No future overnight, random day279 roll or further travel assumed.
